categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Represents the resolution of a fine via timely payment, advancing Maximize timely fine revenue and minimizing administrative and enforcement costs, evaluated against Average time to case closure.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id 12 as observed in variant V0004 where the fine is directly settled.

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Represents the resolution of an enforceable fine via delinquent payment after notification and penalty addition, contributing to timely fine revenue.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id 13, evidenced by variants V0003, V0007, and V0008 where payment occurs following enforcement steps.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Represents handling the case through an administrative appeal to the Prefecture, preserving due-process rights while impacting administrative costs and revenue.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id 14, observed in variant V0006 through insertion and sending of the appeal.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Represents contesting the fine via a judicial appeal to the Judge, strongly supporting due-process rights but hurting administrative cost efficiency.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id 19, supported by variant V0005 ending in an appeal to the Judge.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Represents resolving an enforceable fine through coercive credit collection, helping revenue but hurting administrative costs.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id 20, evidenced by variant V0002 terminating with Send for Credit Collection.
